events.outcome: The annual product remains current, but the legacy $60/$30 economics are stale. Current Essentials is $80 first year and renews at $110/year; activation must occur in the United States.

The website Essentials annual route is kept separate from the distinct $30/360-day eBay Starter Plan. Current official Essentials annual page shows a $120 label, $80 first-year promotion, 3GB/month and $110 renewal; stale $60/$30 guide wording is removed from this canonical route.

data.acquisitionSummary: Official 360-day annual plans from $60 (500MB/mo, $5/mo effective) at redpocket.com/plans/annual; eBay channel sells a $30/360-day unlimited talk+text+200MB/mo plan (still listed Feb 2026). eSIM available on annual plans, all networks (GSMA=AT&T / GSMT=T-Mobile / CDMA=Verizon).

keep.action: Renew the Essentials annual plan; current official renewal is $110/year after the first-year promotional price.

data.chinaActivation: SIM/eSIM activation can only be completed from the United States.
data.payment: Plans are sold for purchase in the 50 U.S. states and Washington, D.C.; physical SIM shipping is domestic only.
data.wifiCalling: Officially supported on ALL networks and works with SMS texting; e911 US address required at setup.
data.roamingSms: Roaming only on GSMA (AT&T) plans: Essentials/Plus/Premium include 60+ country roaming; destination MUST be selected while in the US before departure. China receive-SMS rate not published (null).
data.tariffSummary: Essentials annual: $80 first year promotion, renews at $110/year; standard annual price label is $120.
guideSteps: Directory card: cheapest US annual number, but China-based users cannot activate without US help.
If you have US access: buy $60 annual (GSMA for roaming option), enable Wi-Fi Calling, renew every 360 days.

data.acquisitionSummary: Current RedPocket website Essentials annual product: standard label US$120, current first-year promotion US$80, 3GB high-speed data per month, unlimited talk/text, international calling to 20+ countries and roaming in 60+ countries. The separate eBay $30/360-day 200MB product is normalized under its own route and is not part of these economics.

keep.action: Renew the website Essentials annual plan at the current published US$110 renewal price. RedPocket official annual-plan help defines annual service as 360 days.

data.chinaActivation: SIM/eSIM activation can only be completed from the United States.
data.kyc: No credit check (prepaid); standard account/device/address and anti-fraud checks may still apply.
data.payment: Website plans are sold for U.S. purchase; physical SIM shipping is domestic. RedPocket requires a U.S. card for direct website purchases.
data.wifiCalling: Officially supported on all RedPocket networks and supports SMS text messaging; compatible device and E911 setup are required.
data.roamingSms: Current Essentials includes international roaming in 60+ countries on eligible GSMA service; destination selection must be completed in the United States before departure. Do not transfer this entitlement to the separate eBay route.
data.tariffSummary: Essentials annual: US$120 standard label, currently US$80 first year, 3GB/month, renews at US$110 per 360-day annual term.
guideSteps: Use this route only for the RedPocket website Essentials annual product; the $30 eBay Starter Plan is a separate canonical route.
Activate in the United States, enable Wi-Fi Calling with E911, and if using roaming select the destination in your RedPocket account before leaving the U.S.
Expect promotional first-year pricing to change; renewal is currently published at US$110 for the annual term.
